transcription.text: And this bus here, apparently, I just tweeted this this morning, that the image on the back
here actually confused a Tesla autopilot system. It actually thought it was a person and was
slamming on the brakes and wouldn't, you know, like actually thought there was a person going
to step out from behind the bus. Oops! That's because the Teslas rely 100% on the camera and
image processing. They don't have any LiDAR systems or anything like that. So, yeah, oops!
That confused the poor old Tesla autopilot. Couldn't handle it.
